title: Step 6: Create turns back on before the new page loads, so a second click errors 'code already taken'
where: /admin/new, chat draft and form, right after clicking Create. From code, not seen: clicking would create a real session.
what_happens: Still there in both: session-builder.tsx:111 setCreating(false) and create-session-form.tsx:37 setBusy(false) run before router.push. While the session page loads the button is enabled again; a second click shows 'code already taken'.
who_hurts: An admin who clicks again because nothing seemed to happen: sees an error and thinks creating failed.
suggested_fix: Reset busy/creating only in the !res.ok branch in both files.
